result:
Round 115 (T12 stage 2, multi-clip Clip Gain) is implemented and ready for C. All my checks pass, but none of the browser acceptance rows are verified yet; those are C's. Nothing was committed or pushed.

**What changed**
- **New pure module** (`clip-gain-multi.ts`): a multi-selection gets one shared gain change. At the −60/+24 limits all clips stop together, so their differences stay exact (−6/+1 dragged far right gives +17/+24). Video and unknown clips are ignored.
- **Context**: Clip Gain still has a single pending slot, now keyed by the set of selected clips. The stage-1 single-clip functions keep their signatures and now wrap the shared logic. Five new set-based functions handle groups. Drag previews are always computed from the state before the drag, so they don't add up. After a group commit the status names the count, e.g. `Clip Gain: 2 კლიპი — +11.5 … +18.5 dB.`
- **Panel**:
  - A selection that includes video is disabled with B's exact R1 text.
  - Differing values show an empty field and a range text such as `−6.0 … +1.0 dB`; the fader thumb sits at the highest value.
  - Typing a number, double-click and `0 dB` set every clip.
  - Clip ids are captured when the drag starts (GATE114-S1), and the number field uses the shared step constant (GATE114-S2).
- **Workspace**: computes the new group fields and passes the new props. Doc 098 is updated (R10) and doc 099 is new.

**Checks I ran**
- The new test file has 14 tests: B's 13 plus one for cancel/blur mid-drag that I added after review.
- The targeted list (18 files, 323 tests) passes; typecheck and lint exit 0.
- All six required mutations make the tests fail, plus two for the review fixes.
- The frozen list checks OK at start and end; protected auth/purchase files, `model.ts`, `fader.ts` and the drag hook are unchanged.
- I did not run the full suite, build or `verify` (the gate does). The smoke spec doesn't reference anything I changed.

**Deviations**
- **Block widened from `w-48` to `w-52`** (B allowed up to `w-56`). My Playwright check found that the longest range text squeezed the field from 80 to 72.8 px at 1280. After the fix both viewports measure 208 px with no overflow, and block height is unchanged.
- **Drag scale not narrowed**: I kept the fader's −60 minimum. B's optional narrower minimum would change the drag rate and break MG4 and C's `20/w × 84` formula.
- **Mutation proofs**: two of B's three MG11 cases remount the panel, so they pass with or without the id capture. I added a group-to-group case, and only that one proves it. My first version of mutation m2 was equivalent and survived; the corrected form fails as intended.

**Code review**: the code-reviewer ran and scored it 8.5/10 with no Critical or High findings. I fixed four small items:
- Enter on an untouched mixed field now says "unchanged" instead of "invalid".
- The drag anchor uses the same audio-only rule as the pure module.
- A group double-click at 0.0 is silent, like a single clip.
- A group containing video no longer shows the range text.

**Still open (all Low)**
- **Dead zone after hitting −60**: dragging back, part of the pointer movement does nothing because the frozen drag hook keeps going past the group's floor. C should expect this in MC-CLAMP/MC-FINE.
- **Typed text between groups**: it could carry over between two mixed groups if the selection changed without the field losing focus; I couldn't reach this through the UI.
- **Stale drag-id reference**: it is cleared lazily. This is harmless today.
- **Unfiltered export**: `applyClipGainTargets` is exported without the audio-only filter.

**Architecture note for B/root**: the reviewer proposes, after T12 stage 4, extracting the Clip Gain block into its own component and hook. The two new context refs belong under the existing ARCH-R81 question.

Everything else is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-115.md`: every changed test line, measurements, mutation logs and pointers for C's checks.
